Real Italian food on Mui Ne beach - the gnocchi gorgonzola is a must
Aug 2026 • Family
We didn't expect to find Italian food at this level in Mui Ne. La Riva was a wonderful surprise - authentic, high-quality Italian cooking right by the beach.
The gnocchi gorgonzola was outstanding - rich, creamy and perfectly made - and we paired it with a good bottle of wine. Warm service, relaxed beachfront atmosphere, and you can tell there is real Italian pride in the kitchen.

We came wit
h our family during our Vietnam trip and it was one of our best meals in three weeks of traveling. If you are in Mui Ne, don't miss it.

The Naftaly family, Israel

Average, wouldn't return
Jan 2025 • Couples
We fancied a change from Vietnamese food after 3 weeks travelling round the country, so thought we'd give this Italian restaurant a try.
We had caesar salad for starter, which was actually the best part of the meal, fresh and tasty.
For mains we had the parma ham/buratta pizza and the rigatoni carbonate, both were average. Pizza was soggy on the bottom.
Service was poor at best, struggling to get anyone's attention, despite the restaurant not being full, seems staff would rather be chatting. Spend your money elsewhere.
